name: Chanter ~Kimi no Uta ga Todoitara~
original_name: Chanter-キミの歌がとどいたら-
source:
Every encounter ends in a farewell; every farewell is the prelude to a journey.

It’s the summer season. Mikiya, a third-year high school student, has been living a life free of both excitement and dissatisfaction. If one were to raise one incident, it would probably be his parents’ divorce. Outside of that, nothing of note.
 
Youth might be the time when one craves change, but once getting accustomed to it, this lifestyle of his was pleasant enough. He spent his days aimlessly passing time. The first semester was about to end, with his future still undecided. 

Kousaka Chitose, his childhood friend who carries the strong blood of the barbarian tribes (according to Mikiya).
Ayase Ibuki, the very picture of a student council president (according to Mikiya).
Yoshizumi Kotoko, a club helper with God-bestowed athletic abilities in exchange for proper breasts (according to Mikiya).
Surrounded by this lively group, the days passed by—sometimes filled with joy, sometimes filled with loneliness.
 
Just before summer vacation began, Mikiya experienced a reunion from the past and a new encounter.
 
Shindou Sakura, the beloved daughter of his closest friend, as well as a childhood friend of his.
Nonohara Yuki, a beautiful and pure girl worthy of a beauty queen.
Mikiya’s life becomes increasingly vibrant, joining a band for the school festival and growing closer to the girls.


Mikiya’s school life becomes increasingly vibrant, joining a band for the school festival and growing closer to the girls… What will Mikiya gain from it?

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/views_0241/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
每一场相遇终将以离别收尾；每一次离别都是旅程的序曲。

时值盛夏。高中三年级学生幹也一直过着既无惊喜、也无不满的生活。若要说有什么值得一提的事，大概只有父母离婚。除此以外，再无特别之处。

青春或许正是渴望改变的时期，但一旦习惯以后，他现在的生活也足够舒适。他漫无目的地消磨着时光。第一学期即将结束，未来却仍未决定。

高坂千岁是他的青梅竹马，体内流着浓厚的蛮族血脉（据幹也所言）。
绫濑伊吹是学生会长的完美典范（据幹也所言）。
芳澄琴子是到处为社团帮忙的能手，神明赐予了她超群的运动天赋，却拿走了正常的胸部（据幹也所言）。
被这群活泼的人围绕着，日子一天天过去——有时充满欢乐，有时又满是孤独。

暑假开始前夕，幹也迎来了一场久别重逢与一场全新邂逅。

新堂樱是他挚友的掌上明珠，也是自己的青梅竹马。
野野原雪是一名纯洁美丽、足以当选选美冠军的少女。
幹也的生活日益多彩。他加入为学园祭组建的乐队，也与女孩们愈发亲近。


幹也的校园生活变得越来越精彩。他加入学园祭乐队，也与女孩们日渐亲密……幹也最终会从中收获什么？
